# Bundled frontend libraries

These files are distributed with Cerberus so Markdown rendering and syntax
highlighting do not require loading JavaScript from a CDN at runtime.

| Files | Upstream version | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `marked.min.js` | [Marked 15.0.12](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/tree/v15.0.12) | [MIT and included notices](licenses/marked-LICENSE.md) |
| `purify.min.js` | [DOMPurify 3.2.6](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/tree/3.2.6) | [Apache 2.0 or MPL 2.0](licenses/DOMPurify-LICENSE) |
| `highlight.min.js`, `github-dark.min.css` | [highlight.js 11.11.1](https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js/tree/11.11.1) | [BSD 3-Clause](licenses/highlightjs-LICENSE) |

Keep upstream copyright headers and license files when updating these assets.
Python dependencies retain the licenses supplied with their distributions.
